title: Choose Reconnect's visual direction
question: You asked for a safer hand. Choose a familiar reading structure or re-roll.

options.label: Field guide index
options.lineage: Tabletop sourcebooks and bestiary contents pages
options.thesis: A calm, ordered guide to new writing, with useful categories and publication details visible before the reader opens an article.
options.viewport: Reconnect's masthead, square search and feed controls lead into a clear article index; the most useful story is set apart without hiding the rest.
options.risk: A guidebook reference can feel too much like a tabletop product; keep the real article covers and publication names in charge.

options.label: Periodical reading room
options.lineage: Library magazine racks and current-issue tables
options.thesis: Publication identity comes first, while a clean current-issue index makes articles easy to scan across sources.
options.viewport: A publication-aware masthead and filter rail sit above a clear feed; every story pairs its title with the source, category and date.
options.risk: Too much source-first organization could make a broad discovery feed feel like a directory.

options.label: Game library browse
options.thesis: A familiar image-led catalogue gives every article a strong cover moment, with its real title and source immediately below.
options.viewport: The normal web header and feed controls lead into a varied, image-forward grid; consistent source and date lines keep every tile legible.
options.risk: The game-library reference can resemble a storefront; keep editorial titles and publication credit more prominent than product art.

canonCard.label: The familiar aggregator
canonCard.lineage: Publisher feeds, editorial reading lists and community-post indexes
canonCard.thesis: Use familiar discovery cues: publication identity from Substack, headline-led reading from Medium and scannable topic labels from Reddit.
canonCard.viewport: A standard branded header, search and category filters above a regular article-card grid with clear publication and date metadata.
canonCard.risk: It may be polished but interchangeable. Reconnect should borrow familiar visual cues, not invent Substack subscriptions, Medium reading behavior or Reddit voting and comments.
